```{r}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "survival", "survminer", "skimr", "naniar"))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(skimr)   
```

```{r}
data_raw <- read.csv("ipr_dataset.csv") 
head(data_raw)
```

```{r}
skim(data_raw)
```

```{r}
data_raw %>%
  count(recid_missing = is.na(days_to_recid))
```

```{r}
df <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    event = if_else(!is.na(days_to_recid), 1, 0),
    exit_sup_start_date = as.Date(exit_sup_start_date),
    censor_date = as.Date(paste0(report_fiscal_year, "-06-30")),
    time_days = if_else(
      event == 1,
      days_to_recid,
      as.numeric(censor_date - exit_sup_start_date)
    )
  )


sum(is.na(df$time_days))                      
summary(df$time_days)
df %>% filter(event == 0) %>% pull(time_days) %>% summary()   
df %>% mutate(chk = report_fiscal_year - cohort_fiscal_year) %>% count(chk)  3
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  unite("exit_combined", exit_type, exit_subtype, sep = " - ", remove = FALSE)
```

```{r}
df %>% count(sex, sort = TRUE)
df %>% count(Race, sort = TRUE)
df %>% count(risk_ranking, sort = TRUE)
df %>% count(exit_combined, sort = TRUE)     # adjust name
df %>% count(exit_sup_reason, sort = TRUE)              # adjust name

summary(df$age)
ggplot(df, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Age at Release", x = "Age", y = "Count")

df %>%
  summarise(recid_rate = mean(event), n = n())

df %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(recid_rate = mean(event), n = n())

df %>%
  group_by(risk_ranking) %>%
  summarise(recid_rate = mean(event), n = n())
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)  

pt <- df %>%
  slice_sample(n = 20) %>%
  arrange(time_days) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number())

plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1150), ylim = c(0.5, 20.5),
     xlab = "Days since release", ylab = "Individual", yaxt = "n",
     main = "Time to Reincarceration: Events vs. Censoring")
axis(2, at = 1:20, labels = paste0("P", 1:20), cex.axis = 0.7)
abline(v = 1095, lty = 2, col = "grey60")            # 3-year tracking cutoff
text(1095, 20.4, "3-yr cutoff", pos = 2, col = "grey40", cex = 0.8)

for (i in 1:20) {
  segments(0, pt$id[i], pt$time_days[i], pt$id[i], col = "#3a86d4", lwd = 3)
  if (pt$event[i] == 1) {
    points(pt$time_days[i], pt$id[i], pch = 19, col = "#d1495b", cex = 1.4)   
  } else {
    points(pt$time_days[i], pt$id[i], pch = ">", col = "#3a86d4", cex = 1.4) 
  }
}
legend("bottomright", bty = "n",
       legend = c("recidivated (event)", "censored (no return by cutoff)"),
       pch = c(19, 62), col = c("#d1495b", "#3a86d4"))
```
